automated_checks.method: Actual application scripts execute against a shared simulated DOM. These are behavior checks, not browser layout or full browser end-to-end tests.
website_coverage: Order reservations, preparation usage, and no further deduction when ready
Paused inventory while the kitchen progresses, followed by exactly-once catch-up
Queued cancellation, duplicate and invalid actions, reset, and snapshot isolation
Ingredient conservation across 800 deterministic action iterations
No backend, network, or browser-storage access from the sample
Mobile menu state and resolving relative website assets
Walkthrough manual play, stop, restart, reduced-motion preference changes, image failure and retry
Published screenshot PNG and six-frame GIF signatures
